name: Metatarsalgia
definition: Symptom complex of pain under one or more metatarsal heads due to mechanical overload or a range of underlying forefoot disorders.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; weight-bearing radiographs are used when structural causes are suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent symptoms require diagnosis-specific reassessment rather than generic treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-shoola mechanical phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Symptom complex of pain under one or more metatarsal heads due to mechanical overload or a range of underlying forefoot disorders.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
